map.纸张等级对照表汇总常见纸张等级的分类、质量指标与用途，支持快速查阅，适合印刷选纸: The paper grade comparison table summarizes the classification, quality indicators and uses of common paper grades for quick lookup, suited to paper selection, procurement and process matching reference.
map.印刷选纸、采购比价时，按用途（书刊/包装/食品）在对照表中定位合适等级与关键指标: When selecting paper for printing and comparing supplier prices, locate the right grade and key indicators in the table by purpose (books, packaging, food).
map.工艺匹配时，核对定量、白度、挺度、表面强度、不透明度是否达到客户要求。: When the process matches, check whether grammage, brightness, stiffness, surface strength and opacity meet the customer's requirements.
map.质量争议中，以等级标准对应的指标阈值作为验收依据。: In a quality dispute, the indicator thresholds corresponding to the grade standard serve as the acceptance basis.
map.示例：书刊印刷如何选纸: Example: choosing paper for book printing
map.：在对照表中按『文化用纸→书刊』筛选：常见双胶纸定量 60–120 g/m²，要: In the table, filter by "cultural paper -> books and magazines": typical coated offset paper is 60-120 g/m2, requiring opacity of 85% or more and surface strength for high-speed offset printing. Pick the specific grade by printing method (offset or digital) and image coverage.
map.：对照表以『分类—等级—典型定量—核心指标—用途』组织。核对时优先关注与客户合同: The table is organized as "category - grade - typical grammage - key indicators - use". When checking, focus first on the 1-2 items strongly tied to the customer contract (for example safety compliance and grammage for food packaging, brightness and stiffness for posters) so irrelevant indicators do not distract.
map.纸张等级主要看哪些指标？: Which indicators matter most for paper grade?
map.核心看定量、厚度/紧度、白度、不透明度、挺度、表面强度（拉毛速度）、平滑度。不同: The core items are grammage, thickness/firmness, brightness, opacity, stiffness, surface strength (ring burst speed) and smoothness. Weights differ by use: books and magazines emphasize opacity and smoothness, packaging emphasizes stiffness and burst strength, and food emphasizes safety compliance.
map.对照表能替代标准文本吗？: Can the comparison table replace the standard text?
map.不能。对照表为快速查阅的概览，验收应以最新国家标准/行业标准的指标阈值与试验方法: No. The comparison table is an overview for quick lookup, and acceptance should follow the indicator thresholds and test methods in the latest national or industry standards; the indicators here are common ranges, and the formal standards and the contract govern.
